baselineLabel: Before shared module transform and global interop
method: Same process and fixture root; two warmups per case, nine samples, alternating implementation order; build.write=false. Gzip totals compress each output file separately. Not a startup/runtime benchmark.
scope: Worker and main-thread simple, CSS, TLA and dynamic-import fixtures comparing the supplied baseline and candidate sources.
limitations: The adapter depends on the helper protocol emitted by Vite moduleRunnerTransform.
Emitted chunks must have explicit exports and statically resolvable imports; remaining export-star or computed imports are rejected.
Source metrics count all src/node TypeScript files, including unchanged code, not third-party implementation size.
Existing contracts and targeted tests are not an exhaustive ECMAScript module conformance suite.
